items: A frustum: the footprint w x d at the ground shrinking to w_top x d_top at the top.
A stack of seg slabs, each turned a little further — twist degrees over the whole height.
Stepped like a ziggurat: steps tiers, each h/steps tall and step_in metres narrower on every side.
A rectangle at the ground lofting smoothly to an ellipse at the top.
An elliptical tower, rx by rz in plan.
A curved slab block: a bar of depth w bent around radius r, from angle a0 to a1 (0 = east, 90 = north).
An octagonal prism: the rectangle w x d with its four corners cut back c metres.
The rectangle w x d with corners rounded to radius r, extruded h tall.
A leaning block: the top face slid shear_x / shear_z metres off the base.
